title: Clinical and ecocardiographic results in a 3-and-9-months-follow-up after edeg-to-edge-repair of the mitral valve in patients with combined regurgitation of both AV-valves
summary: Patients with severe mitral-and tricuspidal-valve regurgitation undergo clipping of the mitral-valve as first step, if the risk of surgical treatment seems to high; we want to examine, which patients do better after mitral-valve-clipping and in which patients the additional treatment of the tricuspid valve can be avoided. In addition we want to examine quality-of-life in these very old patient population.

interventions.name: Patients with severe mitral regurgitation who suffer both from mitral-and tricuspid-valve regurgitation and undergo edge-to-edge-repair of the mitral valve at the department of cardiology of the Gemeinschafts-Krankenhaus Bonn.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
congestive heart failure NYHA III/IV
Exclusion criteria:
Dementia (not able to answer the quality of life questionnaire)
